ordering: fonts array order is immutable and is the fallback insertion order
packaging: Separate trusted source/editor font pack; never implicitly embedded in a published renderer crate. Load each named file explicitly with declared digest and byte limits. No runtime discovery or network.
coverage: Common Latin/Greek/Cyrillic, combining marks, Arabic, Hebrew, ten Indic families, Sinhala, Thai, SC CJK and monochrome emoji. Exact scalar coverage is recorded per font; coverage does not imply shaping sequence support or all Unicode scalars.
